book.name: 1 Kolɛŋ
book.title: Ŋwa wù fwe wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Kolɛŋ le

content: Besabɛŋ yɛ̂ne lɛ keefɛ fiɛɛ fì gɛ kooshɛ bɛ bamii ba Ishwalakôoshɛ bɛ besabɛŋ gɛ
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, ŋgoone lɛ bɛŋ kwâjɛ chuule fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ bɛ bachiji chiji besa sege bo gɛ̀ jiɛnyi nchvuuŋ. Bo bachii gɛ̀ jiɛnyi akuu a kimbɛ, bo gɛɛŋ bo daŋ joo yì baaŋ kuu.
No fi gɛ̀ kooshɛ noo, fi mo fi nyu njɛ a kimbɛ kɛɛ le bɛ a joo yɛɛ le bo gɛ̀ kɛmɛ nleesɛ a joo ki bo nyû bamii ba Musɛ.
Bo bachii gɛ̀ jii mwɛɛ munjile mù gɛ̀ nyaa Nyo,
bo muu tɛ joo yì gɛ̀ nyaa Nyo, wu gɛ̀ gee yi bude yi kimbaaŋ le. Kimbaaŋ kiyu gɛ̀ bee Kletu wù gɛ̀ jiɛnyi bɛ bo.
Mo no bo gɛ̀ yɛde mwɛɛ munɛ le nɛ, ba duude bo le tu bo gee gɛh mwɛɛ mù fitele befe Nyo. Wu mo wu yuuyɛ bobaa bamii, agvuŋ aboo giimɛ nchvuuŋ.
Mwɛɛ munɛ gɛ̀ kooshi bɛ bo nyu nteefɛ fɛ besabɛŋ le lɛ keefɛ besabɛŋ gɛ̂ɛ shɛ́ŋ yese yi mwɛɛ mù mbefe le njɛ bo gɛ.
Keefɛ besabɛŋ bûune banyo ba achiji no bamu gɛ̀ buune gɛ. Ba le ba saŋ kune bo lɛ,

content.text: “Bamii gɛ̀ shii, bo ji mwɛɛ, bo mu,
bo ja we bo mo bo lee bine le bo tu bo bine fɛ fimooso le.”

content: Keefɛ besabɛŋ gêe nyiɛŋ yi kinjaŋ no bamu gɛ̀ gee gɛ, Nyo gɛ̀ ge bo kwe banchvuge mbanfiɛɛ ncho batɛde (23,000) yi juu le chimimia.
Keefɛ besabɛŋ mône Tada no bo gɛ̀ mone gɛ, Nyo ge yó taayɛ bo bo kweeyɛ.
Keefɛ besabɛŋ shûŋshi no bamu gɛ̀ shuŋshi, Nchɛndaa wu Kwe yuuyɛ bo gɛ.
Mwɛɛ munɛ munchii mù gɛ̀ kooshi bɛ bo nyu nteefɛ fɛ bamii le. Ba gɛ̀ saŋ nɛ lɛ besabɛŋ banɛ ba chee gɛh nyu yi kife kì woŋ kage wa le, be jôde wɛɛ.
Noo, muh wù kwaji lɛ wu lɛme wu tɛɛme chuule, wu yɛ̂ne lɛ keefɛ wu gê wu gwê gɛ.

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ mmoŋ wuchii wu too fɛ bɛŋ le, le no wu to wu too tɛ fɛ bamii bamu le. Nyo le Nyo wù to wu lɛme gɛh yi jɛ ye le, gɛ taŋlo wu chînɛ lɛ mmoŋ to fɛ bɛŋ le wu fe bvuŋga bwena gɛ. Nɛ mmoŋ too fɛ bɛŋ le, wu dûnyɛ gɛh nyu je yì bɛŋ fê yu bɛŋ so mmoŋ wuyu.
Noo nsáa yaŋ yi shɛ́ŋ, nto sɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ bɛŋ lêge mwɛɛ mu kune banyo ba achiji.
Njɛme bɛŋ le nɛ njɛ bamii ba kɛme bvufee. Bɛŋ taa fɛ bikwɛɛ biɛna le chuule laa fiɛɛ fì njɛme bɛŋ le finɛ le nchiɛɛŋ.

Gɛ besabɛŋ to bee jo fiŋkoo fi ntɛ, bee nya kiyone Nyo le, bee mu yi kintaashɛ le, tu besabɛŋ le be taashɛ yi kilɛmɛ ki Kletu le gɛ? Nɛ besabɛŋ doo be jo blɛd wu yi kife kɛɛ le bee bwɛɛyɛ bee ji yi kintaashɛ le, tu gɛ besabɛŋ taashɛ nyu yi ye yi Kletu le gɛ?
No besabɛŋ jii blɛd wunɛ nɛ nyu bamii ba duude chefe nyu gɛh yimimia, tu fi duunyi lɛ besabɛŋ le ye yimimia, nje besabɛŋ jii gɛh nyu chefe yimimia.
Bɛŋ jo mbejɛ fɛ bamii ba Ishwala le. Muh wuchii wù jii fiɛɛ fɛ kitana ki kintanyɛ le wu taashɛ wa bɛ Nyo yi kintanyɛ kiyu le.
Fiɛɛ fì njɛme finɛ le lɛ la? Fi le lɛ mwɛɛ mù ba gee bintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo le kɛme fiɛɛ ki fi gê kɛnɛ lɛ banyo bayu tɛ kɛme fiɛɛ fì bo ge?

Gɛ nyu noo gɛ. Fiɛɛ fì njɛme le lɛ bintanyɛ bì bamii ba kee gɛ Nyo gɛ gee, bo gee nyu fɛ banchɛndaa ba debele le. Gɛ bo gee nyu fɛ Nyo le gɛ. Mo ntu jɛme lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ tâashi bena banchɛndaa ba debele gɛ.
Gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ mûu a fiŋkoo fi kintaashɛ fi le fi Tada le, bɛŋ ka bɛŋ mûu a fiŋkoo fi Sataŋ le gɛ. Gɛ taŋlo tɛ bɛŋ jîi mwɛɛ munjile mu Tada bɛŋ ka bɛŋ jîi mu Sataŋ gɛ.
Keefɛ besabɛŋ gêe fiɛɛ fì shɛ́ŋ biinyi Tada gɛ. Besabɛŋ goone ki bee dûnyɛ lɛ bee tɛɛme bee fede wu?
Muh gêe fiɛɛ nyu fì taŋlo fi fî tɛ mwa bwee

Besabɛŋ bamu jade bo tu bo duu lɛ bo kɛme bvuŋga ki bo ge fiɛɛ fichii. Geenɛ, bo kêe lɛ gɛ nyu fiɛɛ fichii fì taŋlo fi fî muh gɛ. Lɛ besabɛŋ bamu jade bo tu bo duu gɛh lɛ bo kɛme bvuŋga ki bo gê mo fiɛɛ fichii. Gɛ nyu tɛ fiɛɛ fichii fì taŋlo fi gê muh lɛ̂me wu tɛɛme yi mbɛmɛ we le gɛ.
Keefɛ muh gêe fiɛɛ wu kwaji gɛ no fi kooji fɛ kikwɛɛ ke le gɛ. Muh kwâji tɛ no fi kooji fɛ mwa bwee le.
Bɛŋ jîi nyaŋ yichii yi ba gese fɛ waaŋ, bɛŋ soose gɛ laa yi ja faaŋ la, wu lɛ keefɛ muntele mwɛna sâge bɛŋ yi fifiɛɛ fiɛɛ le gɛ.
Njɛme noo, nje ba le saŋ a Ŋwa Nyo le lɛ,

content.text: “Kɛme Tada woŋ kfunɛ mo mwɛɛ munchii mù le yi wu le.”

content: Nɛ muh wù le gɛ muh wu mbɛmɛ gɛ tɛŋe bɛŋ lɛ bɛŋ tô bɛŋ jii mwɛɛ, bɛŋ bɛɛŋ bɛŋ gɛɛŋ, bɛŋ jîi fiɛɛ fichii fì ba nya bɛŋ le keefɛ bɛŋ sôose gɛ. Keefɛ fitele sâge bɛŋ yi fifiɛɛ fiɛɛ le gɛ.
Geenɛ, muh mu nɛ ja lo wu sɛɛŋ bɛŋ le lɛ mwɛɛ munjile muyu le ba ge kintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo le, keefɛ bɛŋ jî gɛ wu lɛ keefɛ muh wù be sɛŋe bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ lɛ bɛŋ gee fiɛɛ fì befe, mo fɛ fitele sâge muh.
Njɛme fitele finɛ nyu fi muh wù be sɛŋe bɛŋ le. Gɛ njɛme nyu fiena gɛ. Geenɛ, taŋlo muh mu biih lɛ laa taŋlo wu lu ki wù gêe fiɛɛ fì wu koŋe nje fi le fi sâge fitele fì muh mu la?
Nɛ njii fiɛɛ nnya kiyone kiyu Nyo le, muh ka wu nâanyi mɛ nje la?
Mɛ mo nduu fiaŋ lɛ fiɛɛ fichii fì muh gee, kɛnɛ wu jii nyu fijile, kɛnɛ wu muu nyu fimule, wu gêe je yì muh mu yɛŋ lo, wu nyâa mbɛɛŋsɛ Nyo le.
Keefɛ bɛŋ gêe fiɛɛ fì taŋlo fi chɛŋe bɛ muntele mu bamii gɛ, kɛnɛ nyu Bajuu, kɛnɛ nyu bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ, kɛnɛ kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ba Nyo.
Mɛ mone fiaŋ kiŋgee fiɛɛ fichii nyu fì muh wuchii yûge njoŋ. Gɛ ŋkwaji gɛh nyu fiɛɛ fì kune kikwɛɛ kaŋ maa gɛ. Ŋkwaji kune bamii bachii, lɛ ŋgê bo ki bo gê bo bônɛ.

footnotes.text: Kinɛ le kife kì Musɛ gɛ̀ saa fwe ki wu bvûsɛ bo Ijib a Joo yì baaŋ yinɛ le yì ba tɛŋe lɛ yì Yɛɛde (Kinsaŋ 14:21-22).
